birthdays.constraint: character aging appearance, wardrobe, production design, and technology kept period-accurate to each era

detour.objective: maintaining continuity across geography, scale and fast-moving action
detour.character: Character and location sheets established the visual rules
detour.setting: Character and location sheets established the visual rules

dont-poison-ivy.character: Character sheets are built in Nano Banana Pro.
dont-poison-ivy.setting: Scene plates are built in Seedream 5.0 Pro

fallen-leaves.deliverable: widescreen, color short film with a film-emulation finish
fallen-leaves.setting: The film is set in the Sengoku period
fallen-leaves.shot: One scene is shot deliberately warmer and brighter

harmony.constraint: Henri wears a watch always on his left wrist, and only there.
harmony.visual_intention: Always the same blue pot, in the same spot, in the same framing.
harmony.character: Henri has a thin horizontal scar above his right eyebrow.
harmony.setting: There is a book of poems in the house
harmony.shot: Her answer is filmed from her own point of view: the camera itself shakes it.

lost.objective: built out beginning and end and bridged to middle.

prophecy-in-2047.objective: build a whole world properly before shooting a frame of it
prophecy-in-2047.constraint: A maximum of four references resolving in any single frame.
prophecy-in-2047.visual_intention: The palette is locked to yellow, grey and brown.
prophecy-in-2047.character: Wardrobe held as its own element separate from the character
prophecy-in-2047.setting: every location exists as a matched front and reverse plate before any shot uses it

the-last-transmission.constraint: One motivated light source per frame
the-last-transmission.character: a character sheet for each face and a body sheet
the-last-transmission.setting: Two worlds to build: the station deck, and the kitchen inside the CRT
the-last-transmission.objective: Order of work: assets, then stress tests, then the film

the-staff.objective: establishing a proprietary, studio-tier anime production pipeline
the-staff.deliverable: Format: 18-minute episodic anime pilot (split into 8 core narrative sequences).
